title: Asymptotic Analysis of the Narrow Escape and Berg-Purcell problems on general three-dimensional domains with reactive boundary patches
summary: We present an asymptotic analysis of two diffusive capture problems in general smooth closed three-dimensional geometries with multiple small reactive boundary patches of arbitrary shapes. (i) The narrow escape problem seeks to determine the escape rate of Brownian particles from an enclosed region through small boundary windows. (ii) The related Berg-Purcell (or narrow entrance) problem seeks to resolve the capture rate for signaling molecules diffusing outside the cell and entering through localized reactions at membrane-bound receptors.
